title: Duplicates
description: Persons who may be the same human: the same email, or the same name and birth date (likely), or the same name with a birth date unknown (possible). Merge a pair into one person, or mark it as not the same.
loadError: Could not load the possible duplicates.
gone: One of the persons no longer exists or was merged meanwhile.
dismissed: {{names}} are marked as not the same.

dialog.title: Merge two persons
dialog.description: Everything of the duplicate moves to the person that stays: bookings, waiting lists, classes, passes, parents and children, staff links and the account. The duplicate stays hidden for its receipts. A merge cannot be undone.
dialog.notesLabel: Notes of the person that stays
dialog.notesHint: The notes of both, which you may shorten or edit; at most 2000 characters.
dialog.notesTooLong: The notes are too long: at most {{max}} characters. Shorten them to merge.
dialog.fixNotes: Shorten the notes to see what happens.
dialog.twoAccounts: Both persons have an account. The account of the person that goes must be disabled first (ask an administrator); it then stays with that person.
dialog.cycle: After the merge, a parent of this person would also be their child. Remove one of the parent links first.

summary.nothing: The duplicate has nothing to move.
summary.receipts_one: {{count}} receipt stays with the duplicate and is listed under the person that stays
summary.receipts_other: {{count}} receipts stay with the duplicate and are listed under the person that stays
summary.conflicts: Both have these; the duplicate’s goes:
summary.canceled: Booking of {{lesson}} on {{at}} is canceled (a visit it cost comes back)
summary.linksDropped_one: {{count}} parent or child link is dropped
summary.linksDropped_other: {{count}} parent or child links are dropped
summary.history_one: {{count}} booking of a lesson that has started, which both have, is kept as history
summary.history_other: {{count}} bookings of lessons that have started, which both have, are kept as history
summary.canceledByMembership: Automatic booking of {{lesson}} on {{at}} is canceled: the class membership that stays does not include the date
